intro: I’m a full-stack developer based in Oslo, building reliable, accessible digital products across web platforms and business systems. I enjoy turning complicated requirements into elegant interfaces, useful features, and software people can depend on. I also enjoy sparring with AI agents — although they’re still terrible at making coffee.
workIntro: A selection of client work, public-sector products, and independent experiments — from complex services to small tools made with care.

projects.title: DNB · Children’s Card
projects.description: Frontend development for DNB’s children’s debit card ordering journey. I worked on the customer-facing, step-by-step process helping parents request a card for their child, with a focus on clear interactions and usability.

projects.title: Helsedata.no
projects.description: A public-sector service making Norwegian health data easier to find, understand, and request. I worked on frontend architecture, accessibility, complex form workflows, and a clearer experience for researchers.

projects.title: Nortura · Livestock Arrival & Welfare
projects.description: Worked on an internal Power Apps solution for registering and checking livestock arriving at slaughterhouses. Staff could record arrivals, document animal condition, and flag injuries or other welfare concerns through a structured digital workflow.
projects.relatedDescription: Capgemini and Nortura also rolled out a separate ServiceNow Health & Safety reporting platform across 31 factories, with mobile incident reporting and real-time dashboards (live November 2025).

projects.title: Max Byggservice
projects.description: A modern website for a Norwegian renovation company. The experience highlights completed work, explains services clearly, and helps potential customers request a consultation with less friction.

projects.title: Power Apps · Business Solutions
projects.description: Three practical iPad and mobile apps built around Dynamics NAV and Business Central — from customer onboarding to order overviews and rental-equipment testing.

projects.title: Armada Dynamics · Partner Portal
projects.description: Built a partner-facing web portal with login, downloadable EQM Rental add-ins, region-specific price lists, documentation, and a user administration panel. Developed with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Firebase Hosting.

projects.title: borisk.photos
projects.description: My photography portfolio and editorial journal, where I publish personal projects, photo essays, camera reviews, and reflections on shooting digital and film. Built to keep the photographs in focus.

projects.title: Battleship Boards
projects.description: A lightweight web app for generating printable Battleship game sheets, with randomized fleets, single or batch generation, and a clean A4 print layout that makes offline play easy.

experience.description: Developing and customizing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central solutions, focusing on retail and warehouse workflows, AL extensions, integrations, automation, and improving everyday business processes.

Built accessible and scalable web applications across frontend and backend, using React, TypeScript, .NET, Optimizely, and Azure. Worked with complex public-sector services, UI architecture, and delivery through modern DevOps practices.

experience.role: Software Developer · Delivery Architect · Power Apps Developer
experience.description: Customized Business Central and Dynamics NAV for customers, creating extensions, APIs, integrations, and Power Apps. Introduced Azure DevOps and CI/CD practices and helped automate business workflows.

Developed a full-stack price-comparison application for 3D-printing services using Meteor.js, Blaze, and MongoDB. Built reactive user dashboard components, implemented database operations, and improved responsive layouts with Bootstrap.

highlightsIntro: Across enterprise systems and public services, I’ve worked on the architecture, quality, accessibility, and integrations that make software dependable.
about: I’m a software developer in Oslo with experience spanning frontend engineering, enterprise systems, and consulting. I’m happiest when I can take a complex problem from an early idea to a polished, reliable product — whether that means designing an intuitive user journey, building React components, or connecting the systems behind the scenes.

Outside work, photography is a big part of my life. Shooting street scenes, architecture, and film has taught me to look closely at composition, light, and the details that make something memorable. That curiosity carries into the way I build software.
